subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group messages get an opt-in per-sender dynamic subagent model, and which state boundary should own skills, config, memory, and lifecycle?
rationale: Current code has partial routing primitives, but the requested behavior changes product semantics and security boundaries rather than repairing a narrow broken path.

options.title: Design opt-in Feishu group subagents
options.body: Proceed only after maintainers define the Feishu plugin contract for per-sender lifecycle, memory, skills/config, routing, admin controls, and security proof.

options.title: Document existing groupSessionScope path
options.body: Keep the issue limited to sender-scoped group sessions and avoid automatic dynamic agents until demand or API gaps are clearer.

options.title: Defer to shared multi-agent APIs
options.body: Hold this as product discussion until broader channel threading and user-preference APIs settle.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in Feishu group subagents
recommendation.body: Proceed only after maintainers define the Feishu plugin contract for per-sender lifecycle, memory, skills/config, routing, admin controls, and security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies @m1heng as the Feishu plugin community maintainer, making this the best available owner for Feishu-specific product direction.
